API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops List
Apiclient Ops List
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients

Retrieves a paginated list of API clients, providing details such as total records, current page offset, and links for pagination navigation. To learn more, see About API Clients.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
offset
int32

Possible values: >= 0

The starting point for pagination, with the number of records that can be skipped before fetching results.

limit
int32

Possible values: >= 0 and <= 1000

The maximum number of records to return per request. Minimum: 0, Maximum: 1000

name[like]
string

Filters results by name using a partial match.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and a paginated list of API clients is returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
results_total
int64
REQUIRED

The total number of API client records available.

pageOffset
int64
REQUIRED

The starting point of the current page in pagination. Helps determine which set of records is being displayed.

pageSize
int64
REQUIRED

The number of records included in a single response page.

next_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the next page of API client records, if available. Helps to navigate through paginated results.

prev_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the previous page of API client records, if available.

records
object[]
REQUIRED
]
